Permission mode.d: The Claude Code setting that decides what Claude may do without asking you first, from asking before every edit (Manual) to running most actions while a safety check watches (Auto).

Agent loop.d: The repeating cycle an AI agent follows: read the situation, decide on an action, use a tool, look at the result, and decide again, until the task is done.

Shell.d: The program inside a terminal window that reads the commands you type and runs them. Common shells are Zsh (the macOS default), Bash and PowerShell.

PATH.d: An environment variable listing the folders your shell searches when you type a command name. If a program's folder isn't on the PATH you get 'command not found'.

Native installer.d: Anthropic's recommended way to install Claude Code: a one-line script that downloads the program into your home folder and keeps it updated automatically.

Credentials.d: The secret proof of who you are that a program stores after you sign in, such as a login token or API key. Claude Code keeps them in the macOS Keychain or a protected file.
